meta.title: Asset Map · sourced UI sample
meta.coverage: 12 illustrative relationships across BlackRock, Berkshire Hathaway, Amazon and Nestlé; SpaceX is a hub without loaded ownership links.
notes: UI prototype sample only. This is not a comprehensive ownership database or a live portfolio.
Each relationship has its own source date. Acquisition-completion dates are historical observations; annual filings are year-end snapshots.
Corporate ownership of a manager is separate from investments managed for clients. No client portfolio look-through is included in this sample.
Unknown percentages and USD values are null, never zero. Percentages may use different denominators; inspect each relationship's notes.
Group-level subsidiary links may omit intermediate legal entities and do not necessarily assert direct shareholding.
For undated official webpages, asOf is the date verified. SpaceX has no ownership edges because its cap table has not been ingested.
